resources.string: Ek baar download karna hoga (lagbhag 30 MB). Iske baad Ubuntu aur jo bhi install karein, woh phone mein rahega.
Yeh phone\'s processor type (%1$s) is supported nahi. Termant ko ARM ya x86-64 chahiye.
Ubuntu download ho raha hai… %1$d of %2$d MB
Band karne ke liye tap karein
Yeh phone mein voice typing app nahi hai. Keyboard ki microphone key ka istemal karein.
Model list load ho rahi hai…
Model list agent download hone ke baad dikhegi. Pehle ek chat message bhejein.
Model list load nahi hui. Internet connection check karein.
Sirf letters, numbers, dot, dash aur underscore use karein.
Chat mein kaunsa AI model jawab degi.
Ubuntu mein woh folder jahan agent files rakhta aur run karta hai.
Dark ya light mode chunein. Badlav ke liye app ek baar band karke kholein.
Theme change karne ke liye app restart karein.

Optional. Bina key ke, free models use hote hain. Key ke saath, company\'s models appear in the model list aur billed hote hain aapke account par. Keys sirf phone par rahein, Ubuntu ke ~/.config/termant/keys.env mein.
Yeh API key jaisa nahi lagta (spaces ya quotes nahi hone chahiye).
Save ho gaya. Model list mein is provider ka model chunein.
Woh servers jinse AI agent connect ho kar tools ke taur par use kar sakta hai, jaise files padhna ya commands chalana. OpenCode khud unse connect hota hai.
Abhi koi MCP server nahi hai.

Rules khud chal rahe hain, phone restart ke baad bhi, jab tak Termant force-stop nahi hua. Chat mein pooche kar banayein, jaise: "roz raat 11 baje WiFi band karo" ya "jab charging lage toh backup chalao".
Sirf un rules ya requests ke liye jo text message bhejte hain.

Model\'s provider ne request refuse ki. OpenRouter key ke saath yeh aam taur par matlab: model free nahi hai aur account mein credit nahi hai, free daily limit khatam ho gaya, ya OpenRouter ki privacy settings mein free models block hain. :free naam wala model ya koi doosra provider chunein.
%1$s par switch ho gaya: %2$s jawab nahi diya (limit khatam ya available nahi).
Doosre models bhi try kiye gaye; koi jawab nahi diya.
Jab model jawab dena band kar de, aam taur par free limit khatam hone ki wajah se, app khud agla backup model try karegi. Woh model 3 ghante tak chalu rahega jo kaam kiya.

Models jin par switch kiya ja sakta hai, list ke upar se neeche try kiye jayenge. Koi tick na karein sab free models use karne ke liye. Jiske paas aapki key hai us provider ke models paise le sakte hain jab tak wo free plan par na ho.
Browser mein arena.ai website kholta hai, jahan sign in karke use karein. Ye chat se alag hai: ye phone ya Ubuntu control nahi kar sakta.
Yeh phone par koi browser app nahi mila.

resources.string: Nayi sessions mein phone storage /sdcard par hai.
Ek session band karein pehle, phir doosra kholein.
Yeh Ubuntu, har installed package aur usmein ki gayi har file ko delete kar dega, phir fresh copy download karega. Phone storage ko chhua nahi jayega.

Termant %1$s
Ek asli Ubuntu 24.04 userland aapke phone par, bina root ke. Software install karein:
apt update apt install <package>
AI ke liye tap karein OpenCode, ek AI coding agent jo aapke liye code likh kar chala sakta hai.
Text size change karne ke liye pinch karein. Select aur copy karne ke liye long-press karein.
Open source (GPLv3). Terminal Termunk dwara, userland PRoot dwara, system Ubuntu dwara, agent OpenCode dwara.
